The state of New York – led by Governor Hochul – is pushing a policy that bars cooperation with ICE. Senate Republicans cannot let this stand.
 
New York is in open defiance of federal law by refusing to assist with the deportation of illegal immigrants. Their policy choices are a magnet for future illegal immigration. New York’s decision to continue sanctuary city policies harms the entire nation and the politicians who support these measures should pay a price.

The idea that Iran would not completely destroy all their enrichment facilities as part of a negotiated solution makes no sense. The moratorium - without complete dismantlement of the enrichment facilities and capabilities - truly becomes the JCPOA. 

I am certain that Iran’s refusal to destroy their enrichment capability will be soundly rejected.

I appreciate President Trump’s earnest efforts to seek a diplomatic solution to change the behavior of the Iranian terrorist regime. However, between their constant attacks on international shipping, the persistent attacks on our Middle Eastern allies and now a totally unacceptable response to America’s diplomatic proposal, it is in my view, time to consider changing course. 

Project Freedom Plus sounds pretty good right about now.

I hope everyone had a Happy Mother’s Day full of love and joy. 

It’s hard to believe it’s been almost 50 years since I lost my dear mother. Her love and influence will last a lifetime, like so many other mothers.

Iran’s continued attacks on international shipping and against our allies tells me all I need to know about who we are dealing with here. 

President Trump’s overview of how past presidents have missed the mark in dealing with the Iranian terrorist regime is spot on.  It is apparent to me that Iran believes that President Trump is bluffing when it comes to future military options. 

From my understanding of the situation, that could be a disastrous mistake by the Iranian leadership. Stay tuned.

The idea of Project Freedom Plus is very intriguing and I believe it can bear fruit. Providing a path for safe passage of international shipping in the Strait of Hormuz — in the face of Iranian resistance — is a game changer. The plus part in my opinion would envision more international partners and limited kinetic activity. 

As to a negotiated settlement, it must include the end of Iran’s state sponsorship of terrorism through their support for Hezbollah and other terrorist organizations.

I’m grateful for the people committed to keeping South Carolina a place where future generations can hunt, fish, shoot, and enjoy the outdoors we all love. 

Thank you for your support.

Congratulations to all the law enforcement officers who received the South Carolina Sheriffs’ Association Medal of Valor this week in Columbia.
 
Thanks to their efforts, crime in South Carolina is at a record low, and I’m pleased these local heroes were honored with the recognition they have earned.
 
Each day, our brave men and women in uniform put their lives on the line to keep our state safe. I will always have their back.

Communist China’s flagrant disregard of American sanctions against Iran’s oil and gas products needs to be challenged. 

China is the largest purchaser of Russia’s oil and gas. China also openly flouts sanctions by buying Iranian oil, propping up the terrorist regime. While we all hope for a better relationship with China, this abuse by China needs to be addressed. 

I would urge @POTUS and his team to put China on notice that their behavior regarding Russia and Iran is unacceptable.
